newsitem.title: USA: Marsh to buy Johnson & Higgins - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Marsh to buy Johnson & Higgins - WSJ.

text.p: Marsh & McLennan Cos is expected to announce today a pact to acquire insurance broker Johnson & Higgins for $1.8 billion, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Wednesday.
The paper said people familiar with the matter believe the acquisition will be for a mix of stock and cash and add to earnings.
A day earlier Johnson & Higgins, the third largest insurance broker in the United States, decined to comment on reports that it was considering going public or selling itself.
Wednesday's report said the deal with Marsh & McLennan would include Johnson & Higgins' benefits consultant business, A. Foster Higgins & Co, which is one of the world's largest in the industry.
